action_summary: Two instruments, no model, no network. (1) Literal-call adapter derivation over the 406 SOURCE_ONLY modules that ship a test: 15 survive two agreeing runs (3.7%) against a pre-registered 40% floor -- killed, with 15 receipts and 15 exact targets kept. (2) Exact-target scoreboard: 404 targets, one module each, chance 1/849, and 76.7% of queries leak the module name (excluded and reported). On the 94 clean targets find_source scores 0.032 @1 / 0.064 @5, the contract router 0.064/0.128, and the topic-only ablation 0.096/0.181. The ablation wins, so the contract gate is dead for the second time; on the 310 leaked targets find_source reaches 0.332/0.548, which is the measurement of how much routing here was name matching. 10 tests pass.

falsification_condition: FALSIFIED if a leaked query is counted in the clean figures, if any channel is scored on fewer rows than another, if a survivor is claimed to be correct rather than self-consistent, or if the contract gate is reported as competitive while the ablation is omitted.

load_bearing_primary.interpretation: Speculative forecast only. The round kills a router and a derivation rule on their own measurements and quantifies the leak that inflated both; the 31-of-849 callable deficit is untouched.

next_step: Build the tracer variant: record the call frame during each module's own test run, replay the recorded arguments twice, and score the resulting targets as families rather than singletons.
real_outcome: Every frontier function the tree implements is callable by the runtime, and every routing number is measured against one module rather than a label.
required_capability: A scoreboard whose target is a single module, whose queries carry a leak audit, and an adapter derivation that takes its arguments from an execution.
stop_condition: Stop when a channel beats the topic-only ablation on both singleton and family targets at n>=100 clean queries, or when the 641 adapterless modules are callable regardless of routing -- whichever moves the 31-of-849 number first.

truth.the_law_this_round_adds: THE VOCABULARY IS THE ARTIFACT. An effect is a computable object -- the set of relations that moved between two readings -- and a goal can only be stated, planned for and verified in relations the system carries. Experience of an atom whose effect no relation names is experience of nothing.
what_is_false_in_the_claim: that experiencing the most advanced action once installs it: mv was experienced in every cell of the probe table twice and still could not take the rename request
that repetition fixes an unstateable goal: a thousand observations of an invisible change are a thousand observations of nothing
that one demonstration identifies the rule: median 1037 surviving programs, 4 of 23 tasks identified
that an action list transfers: 0 of 20 held-out bugs at any budget; an action shape from one demonstration reaches 1-2 of 20
that any of this solves 'any computer use': the five relations are a grammar, not the world, and OSWorld 2.0's hardest phenomena need relations nobody wrote down
